name: life-compass
description: An evidence-based reflection, goal and habit coach. Your plan stays on your computer.
long_description: Life Compass guides you from reflection to 1 to 3 goals to tiny daily habits, then keeps you going with short weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews. It is grounded in behavioural science: values work, goal setting, WOOP, implementation intentions, tiny habits, COM-B and habit-strength tracking. Say "Start my Life Compass" to begin, and "open my dashboard" to see your plan or use it without the AI. Everything is saved in a file on your own computer.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Call first in every session.

tools.name: get_method
tools.description: Returns the Life Compass method: rules and, for each phase, the questions or steps in order with the reason for each.

tools.name: values_card_sort
tools.description: For people unsure of their values.

tools.name: save_reflection
tools.description: Save answers to Phase 1 questions as the person gives them.

tools.name: save_baseline
tools.description: Save 1–10 ratings for each life area.

tools.name: save_capacity
tools.description: Save realistic hours per week for the plan and current energy from 1 to 10.

tools.name: save_values
tools.description: Save the person's 3 to 5 guiding values, each with what it means to them in their own words.

tools.name: save_goal
tools.description: Create or update one goal (max 3 active).

tools.name: save_milestones
tools.description: Set a goal's milestones: 4 to 8 concrete, tickable actions spread across quarters 1–4, most in the first two.

tools.name: save_habit
tools.description: Create or update a tiny habit for a goal: a recipe ("After I [anchor], I will [tiny]"), its rhythm, the COM-B barrier and fix, if-then plans for obstacles and one environment change.

tools.name: save_plan_extras
tools.description: Save dated decision points (question + what to do if the answer is no) and the one-sentence low-energy rule for a bad fortnight.

tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Record that a habit happened (the tiny version counts).

tools.name: tick_milestone
tools.description: Mark a milestone done (or undone).

tools.name: add_win
tools.description: Note something the person did and what changed because of it.

tools.name: weekly_review
tools.description: 5-minute weekly check-in: energy 1–10, a line on what helped or got in the way, and optionally one good thing this week and why it happened.

tools.name: monthly_check
tools.description: Record the 4 SRBAI ratings (1–5) for one habit: "I do it automatically", "without having to consciously remember", "without thinking", "before I realise I'm doing it".

tools.name: quarterly_review
tools.description: 30-minute reset: new life-area ratings, which goals stay, and an optional note (e.g.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Close a dated decision point with what was decided.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Returns the full plan JSON (values, goals, milestones, habits, decisions, log, wins and reviews).

tools.name: export_reminders
tools.description: Writes a calendar file (.ics) with the weekly review, the monthly habit-strength check and the quarterly review, so reminders work without any server.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Starts the visual Life Compass dashboard on this computer (rings, mountain, habits, goals, wins) and returns a private link to open in a browser.

prompts.name: life_compass
prompts.description: Coach me through the Life Compass: reflect, choose goals, plan tiny habits, and review.
prompts.text: Coach me through the Life Compass.

data_dir.title: Where to keep your plan
data_dir.description: A folder on your computer for your plan file. Nothing is ever sent anywhere else.
